name: PoP Key-Binding EAT Profile
description: Binds a subject public key to an attested execution environment. Carries the key-attributes claim (private label 73010) alongside the standard cnf claim (RFC 8747, label 8) so a relying party can verify the key was generated inside the attested environment rather than imported.
notes: Published under this domain because urn:ietf:params: is IANA-controlled and the underlying draft was never WG-adopted; a dereferenceable URI needs no registration. Version 0.1 tracks the draft revision this implementation targets.
